t2_training_question: Can a learned natural-language operator encoder over the frozen full N0 semantic hidden-state stack recover the ordered relation, role, operation, and control operator needed by the exact frozen T1 executor, while structural support and focus remain oracle?

training_design.semantic_hidden_state_policy: materialize all 17 token-state layers once inside the governed P100 run; cache fp16, train T2 in fp32
training_design.special_token_policy: exclude tokenizer special tokens from T2 attention mask
training_design.continuous_operator_training: supervised contrastive operator-signature objective across natural-language views in addition to discrete operator heads
training_design.t1_executor: exact selected step50 T1 checkpoint, frozen
training_design.why_continuous_context_not_injected: T1 was trained with zero operator context; injecting a new varying context would change the frozen executor input distribution and confound T2
training_design.selection: first DEV checkpoint satisfying both exact operator and downstream T1 contracts, then stop

failure_policy.if_model_gate_fails: preserve all result, cache, metric, and checkpoint evidence; do not tune LR/steps or rerun automatically; localize operator component versus semantic representation versus downstream executor interaction first
failure_policy.if_infrastructure_fails: classify and repair the infrastructure boundary without treating it as model evidence; preserve valid partial artifacts
